canonical.title: Divide Array in Sets of K Consecutive Numbers
canonical.sourceFilePath: 09. Heaps/2. Medium Problems/07. Divide array into sets of K consecutive number.cpp

narrative.title: The Hotel Room Block Allocator
narrative.scenario: A hotel allocates room blocks to tour groups: each block must be k consecutive room numbers, and every room number in the inventory list must be used exactly once. The allocator walks room numbers in ascending order, and whenever it opens a new block at a room, it must be able to claim the next k-1 rooms without conflict.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums of room numbers and an integer k, the block size.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if the inventory can be partitioned into sets of k consecutive numbers, false otherwise.
constraints: nums.length is divisible by k for a valid partition

testCases.explanation: Blocks [1,2,3,4] and [3,4,5,6] consume every room exactly once.
Four rooms cannot split into blocks of three.

hintLevels: Level 1: Scan values in ascending order; the smallest unclaimed value must start a block.
Level 2: When value v starts a block, all of v+1..v+k-1 must be available in matching quantity.
Level 3: Consume whole runs at once (decrement by the starting count) to stay linear after sorting.
